reviews.text: Jessy loves going to the spa 🤗

Our baby Leya goes twice a week and LOVES it!!! Excellent for socializing with other dogs and burning off energy with all the activities they provide… afterwards she comes back calmer and sleepy… but immediately looking forward to the next time she can play and be happy again…
Thank you @cpetcare 💕

C's Pet Care is genuinely the best daycare we could have asked for.
Our dog has been going there since he was 4 months old, and he's grown up with the daycare experience. He's an extremely social, happy, and well-behaved dog (most of the time 😂).
We chose this daycare because it doesn't have too many dogs, and it has several small breeds to play with our dachshund.
He loves being there, and we've loved his development.
Another perfect thing is the constant feedback with photos and videos throughout the day. WE LOVED IT!!!

Thank you for everything 😊

Carolina is a natural pet sitter. Attentive and available, she does a serious and responsible "job." I put "job" in quotes because for Carolina, taking care of animals is more than that: it's a mission and a pleasure! My dog, after spending a few days with her and going for walks, already seemed to replace me! A dedicated, sensible, conscientious professional, with great balance and discernment in her duties, she makes us feel confident when we entrust our furry friend to her.

I highly recommend her!
My German Shepherd takes a bath there every month!
Thank you for the day, Pablo is here, all happy, as always waiting for me to drop him off at daycare!!! I don't know if he doesn't like you guys more than me 😉 what you do is beautiful ❤️

Good afternoon, I want to thank you for the kind and fantastic way you treated my Nala. I wholeheartedly recommend it; it was the place I liked the most and felt most at ease. Besides the friendliness, the space is very hygienic and spacious. Thank you very much.

I couldn't be happier with my choice of daycare. I really like the space and, especially, the caring and attentive way they treat all the animals, particularly my dog. 🐾

It's incredibly reassuring to leave her in the morning knowing she's in good hands. At the end of the day, she comes home happy, and that's undoubtedly the most important thing to me.

Thank you to everyone who is part of this team!! 🤎

Stormy joined this daycare when she was just 4 months old, a Toy Poodle, and from day one I never had any fear leaving her, even though she was in the large dog classes.

Over these almost 2 years, she has never had any problems and is very well cared for by Carolina and the whole team. The care and attention they give to all the dogs is noticeable, and that inspires enormous confidence.

They also take care to send photos and short videos throughout the day, which always puts us at ease and allows us to follow a little bit of their day. 🤍

It's even funny to see her, at 4 kg, interacting so naturally with dogs weighing 40 kg! 😄 But, above all, what reassures me most is seeing her so happy. Just look at her reaction when she arrives and when she sees Carolina to understand how much she enjoys being there.

For me, that says it all. 🤍🐾

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I couldn't be happier! 🐶❤️ It's wonderful to know they spend their days playing, barking, running, and above all, very happy and well cared for.

The whole team shows enormous affection and care for our little ones, which leaves us completely at ease while they are there. 🥰

I also love the thoughtfulness of sending us daily updates with photos and videos, allowing us to follow their day and see how happy they are. It's a small gesture that makes all the difference and fills our hearts. ❤️

I wholeheartedly recommend this daycare to everyone looking for a safe, fun place where our furry friends are treated with genuine affection. 🐾💗
Carolina is a great professional ☺️ She treats all the animals entrusted to her with care. Not only her, but the whole team. I highly recommend her!!

The best decision I ever made was putting my little one in daycare. C' Pet Care was the daycare I chose, and I don't regret it.
I noticed that my dog ​​was becoming more and more lethargic each day, she seemed listless, gaining weight uncontrollably, and I didn't know what to do.
I spoke to them, and they explained how the daycare worked. They did a behavioral assessment on Lia, and she was admitted.
Since then, and even though she only goes once a week, she has lost weight, is more cheerful and playful, and whenever we talk about going to daycare, her tail wags as if she's been told the best thing in the world.
I also started noticing that whenever I arrive at the daycare's entrance, she leans against the door and goes in with all her might and happiness.
During the day, they send me photos and videos of her playing, eating, and resting. These videos and photos have become the best part of my day.

So, I want to thank you for your work and dedication during these months that Lia has been in your care.

Thank you!

5-star service
We loved the service, friendliness, and attention given to all the furry friends 🐾🤎
Pablo loves his days at daycare...
I highly recommend it.

Excellent, excellent, excellent work by Carolina and her collaborators, all hand-picked: extremely dedicated, caring, and concerned about the dogs. Our dog was always received with affection and all the attention that only someone who truly loves animals can give. It's a day of rest knowing that she's in such good hands, and she returns home calm, as if she's been mentally stimulated and not just physically exhausted. There's immense care in forming the groups and concern that each dog can develop friendships and playtime to the extent they enjoy. A very special place for Tília and for us.
We received photos and videos throughout the day, which is wonderful.
The space is always well-maintained and safe, something I valued highly when choosing a daycare, with no risk of escape.
I recommend it 100%!

I couldn't be happier with C’ Pet Care! 🐾🤎

From day one, I felt that my Gordi was received with great affection, professionalism, and dedication. The team is extremely attentive, inspires confidence, and keeps us informed through photos and videos, which makes all the difference for those who leave their best friend in the care of others.

The love they have for animals and the individual care they give to each dog is evident. Mine loves going to daycare; he comes back happy, exhausted, and well cared for. Knowing that he is in a safe, fun environment surrounded by people who truly care about his well-being leaves me completely at ease.

I 100% recommend them to any pet owner looking for a trustworthy place for their four-legged companion. Thank you for all the affection, dedication, and professionalism! 🐶🤎
My Lord loves going to Carolina's daycare.
Excellent service and professionals! Congratulations!

Our Zaya is the happiest baby in the world thanks to CPET and I think the pictures speak louder than 1000 words.
Only you guys make Zaya smile so much 😅
Thank you for all the love you give, for everything you teach and for being a second home 🤍

Cacau started going due to separation anxiety, and although my dog ​​is the most "dramatic" of the bunch, she's always welcomed and treated like family. A huge thank you to the team for what they do, for always sending videos and photos while she's at daycare, for the attention and care they give her. The team is very experienced and kind. I definitely recommend this daycare!!

We regret that your feedback comes from our neighbor, H2Dog Leça do Balio Dog Daycare, and is intended to damage our image.

We invite you to come and visit us!

Thank you and see you soon!
This daycare treats my Chloe very well. They provided a safe and welcoming environment. They are attentive and concerned about animal welfare. I recommend them.

5* Service

It's sad that people running a business have to try to unfairly denigrate "the competition" (inciting other people, who know nothing about the place in question, to rate it with one star), perhaps because they see their business volume starting to decline, not only because of the undeniable and unquestionable quality of the service provided by Carolina and her team at C' Pet Care, but perhaps also because of internal incidents (including negligence), to the point of resorting to threats.

P.S.: Talking about (issues of lack of hygiene and) mistreatment is simply absurd! 😅
Incredible friendliness.

Our Farol loves this daycare! He always goes happy and comes back even happier. You can see the affection, dedication, and care of the whole team, not only for my Farol but for all his little friends. You can see how well he is treated and how much they really like animals.
We feel very reassured knowing that he is in good hands. 💛🐾 I wholeheartedly recommend this daycare.
My dog ​​stayed with Carolina for a few days and I recommend her without hesitation. She was very patient with his reactivity and treated him very well.
Top
5-star service
Best place to take care of our dog. It's so good to have found a place where I can go to work and have peace of mind knowing that my dog ​​receives the best treatment I've ever seen in a dog daycare.

Our little Aylinha has been coming to this place since she was a puppy, and I honestly dare say it's one of the places where she feels happiest!!
The whole team is fantastic, especially Carolina, the manager, who takes such good care of our furry friends, who worries about them and gives them affection as if they were her own.
For me, one of the most important things in a daycare is feeling that there is love for the animals, and here there is love to give and sell 🥰. Carolina makes our furry friends not even miss us, and that is priceless 🙏🏽.

We regret that your feedback comes from our neighbor, H2Dog Leça do Balio Dog Daycare, and is intended to damage our image.

We invite you to come and visit us!

Thank you and see you soon!
A daycare with excellent service, with a team that is always available and caring. I highly recommend it!
CPet Care has an amazing and highly professional team, always attentive to the needs of the animals and very careful in everything they do.

I'm writing to express my satisfaction and gratitude for all the excellent work that all the monitors do! The care, dedication, and hygiene are noticeable as soon as we enter. My dog ​​only started attending daycare in January, and I already notice a huge difference in his socialization with the other dogs and his joy at knowing that we are leaving home to go to daycare. Both Carolina and everyone involved in this project dedicate themselves wholeheartedly, and only those who have their animals there can witness that!
Thank you to the whole team and kisses from Cookie.

Fantastic daycare, fantastic team with the animals.

Do the dogs bark during their stay at daycare?
It's good that they bark, it's because they are happy and constantly socializing.
Keep up your fantastic work.

We will always be available to help…

Invicta Dog Daycare

We regret that your feedback comes from our neighbor, H2Dog Leça do Balio Dog Daycare, and is intended to damage our image.

We invite you to come and visit us!

Thank you and see you soon!
Excellent service 🐾 …

Nala loves going to daycare! It's a super well-cared-for daycare, with monitors who care about her. Nala has never come home dirty or smelling like dog, and it could happen, but they take great care of her.
Dogs bark, it's true, but that's how they express themselves.
I recommend it 100%, it's a daycare with a very family-like atmosphere and that's what I like most about leaving Nala there. ❤️

The best place to leave my furry friend. She's never been as happy as she is at C'Pet Care, to the point that she doesn't even want to come home at the end of the day.

Controlled environment, prepared and fun environment for the furry friends, the owner and staff are super attentive to their "students". And as for the dogs barking, that's normal, because I've seen two-legged "animals" who also don't know how to frequent public places. To anyone who is in doubt, I advise you to go there in person and see the space with your own eyes.

Thank you C'Pet
Kisses from Camilinha

My furry friend has been going to C Pet Care since he was 4 months old, and I couldn't be happier! From Carolina, who treats Archie like his own, to the safe and loving environment created by all the girls who work there, the affection, patience, and dedication they have for each animal is noticeable. We always feel that our dog is in experienced hands, who understand his individual needs and make sure to provide him with a day full of joy, safety, and lots of playtime.

Archie loves all the activities, carefully designed for the well-being and development of the pets, from group playtime to moments of rest and socialization. It's very reassuring to know that I can fully trust this team, and that my pet not only has fun but also grows socially, learns, and maintains a healthy routine.

Communication with the owners is excellent; they are always available to share moments from our pet's day. I wholeheartedly recommend C Pet Care to all owners looking for a safe, fun, and loving place for their dogs!

Thank you for your feedback. We regret that it comes from our neighbor H2 Dog Leça do Balio Dog Daycare – an attempt to denigrate our business.

We invite everyone to come and see our space, facilities, and how all hygiene protocols are followed, with constant monitoring of students and supervision!

As well as speaking and clarifying doubts with our client tutors!

Thank you!

For any other questions, we are at your disposal.
Lovely place that takes cares of my sister dog since he was a little rascal 😁 …

My dog ​​is treated with great care! They send photos throughout the day so I can follow his progress.
I recommend them.

I have nothing but good things to say about this place! They are super careful, attentive, and keep giving feedback to the owners while the animals are there. I am really very satisfied with C’Pet Care's service and I recommend it to anyone looking for a trustworthy place to leave their canine companion.

I'm writing to express my immense satisfaction. My dog ​​has been attending this daycare for over a year, and a large part of my satisfaction comes from seeing the care, dedication, hygiene, and affection he receives. It's sad to see the destructive comments here, all made at once, trying to ruin the success of a professional who is so skilled and capable in her field. But I can say with certainty, my dog ​​LOVES this daycare; if we could, he'd go every day, and Carol has our trust. I highly recommend it! Besides, my dog ​​is extremely happy there, and we, his owners, are too!
The best day care for our dog, couldn't recommend it enough.
My dog ​​is very happy at CPet Care and with her friends!!

I couldn't ask for a better daycare for our little girl! She loves being there and is treated wonderfully by all the caregivers. We always get real-time updates, photos, and videos. I trust them 1000%.
Congratulations on your professionalism!!!! Only a daycare like this would be suitable for me to work at!!! Safety, affection, and stimulation at all times!!! ❤️
Top team! The best place for our furry friends.
The best daycare in Porto! My Vienna is very happy, and Carolina and her team are the best for all the furry friends. Rigorous, demanding, clean, and with lots of love for all the pets.

A shop that's always noisy with dogs constantly barking. I'm worried about how they're treated there. Unfortunately, in addition to that, they try to tarnish the good name of other quality shops just because they've already faced criminal charges due to comments like mine.

C' PET CARE is a unique daycare where our Benji is treated with all the love and care.
We've been there since the beginning and have been following the growth of this project, which has been getting better and better, more fun, with great ideas and initiatives to make our furry friends' days more cheerful.
We trust Carolina completely!

This experience has been incredible for Valentim! 💛
Carolina and the whole team are super attentive, and you can see that in his enthusiasm every time he arrives.
You can tell that Tim is really well treated and has a lot of fun. Since he started going, we've noticed a huge improvement in his behavior and socialization. And he always comes back so happy 🥰
Thank you, Carolina, for taking such good care of our little big love! 💛

Wonderful place, with lots of activities for the dogs. Lots of love, fun and care for our Bigo. We are entirely grateful to the girls and especially to Carol for their dedication to their work and the affection given to our furry friends. I highly recommend it!!! Bigo loves the daycare so much!!!!

Our dog attends the C’Pet Care doggy daycare and we have nothing but good things to say. All the staff are very attentive and careful in every aspect. We feel that our dog shares the same opinion and the day she goes to daycare is a very happy day for all of us.

Super professional, super sweet!

They treat our animals as if they were their own 🫶🏽 absolutely nothing to complain about!

We loved them!!! And we highly recommend them.

Carolina is 5*! 😊 Super friendly, sweet, involved, motivated, and communicative. She keeps us engaged in everything, whether it's with information, photos, and videos she sends daily when Ozzy and Penny are at daycare. ❤️ It's a very cute and stylish space, inside and out. The dogs do different activities throughout the day, and Carolina shares all of that. It's a family daycare, and we really like that. 😊 And we know that with Ozzy and his barking, playful interactions, and zoomies; and Penny, cute but crazy about the neighbor's cat, it won't be easy to 'put up with'. 😅 Thank you! 🙏 And Halloween 🎃 was great! 😘 And Christmas was even cuter. 🎄

C’Pet Care is an amazing daycare for our furry friends.
I leave Kiba in their care every week, and the love and attention he receives is incomparable. I recommend and will always recommend Carolina and the girls at C’Pet Care to everyone. Excellent establishment, excellent staff, excellent space. It undoubtedly deserves 5 stars.

Mel loves daycare. The interaction she has with her doggy friends, with the owner of the place, Carolina, and with "grandma" Catarina is fantastic. I feel at ease when I leave her there because I know she's in good hands. Mel is very mischievous, she barks a lot, but that shows how happy she is.
On daycare days, she gets super excited to the point of almost dragging me to go to the garage.
The fact that there are themed parties (birthdays, carnival, Halloween, Christmas, etc.) brings us much closer to the reality experienced in children's daycares, and that's a lot of fun.
I recommend the place; I can't find any negative or less good points.

C'PetCare is a dog daycare that does an incredible job with the dogs every day. They are very careful with the groups and which dogs they put together, evaluating the dogs before they are admitted. Carolina is wonderful with all the dogs, my Yoda loves her and never wants to leave!!!! He is a very happy dog, who plays, interacts, gets lots of cuddles and rests. Keep up the excellent work ❤️🙏
Perfect daycare for animals!! Super caring :)
This is no ordinary daycare. Here, the care for the pets is personalized and of the highest quality. Excellent communication with pet owners and innovative activities. I highly recommend it!!
Quality service, with professionalism and great dedication.

Excellent service!! The love, affection, and care they have for all the furry friends is impressive. You can tell they take care of the animals like someone who has a lot of love for what they do!! As soon as Cali approaches the daycare, her joy becomes contagious. I've never seen a dog daycare work so well.
They are fantastic. Congratulations, and I hope you continue to take care of our furry friends for many years to come. We depend a lot on your continuity.
Thank you for everything you do!!

Our Ariel has been coming to the spa weekly for almost a year, and our experience couldn't be better!
You can see the constant concern for the well-being of all the furry friends!
For me, it was lucky to have found a place where we feel 100% safe leaving her!
It's also worth noting Carolina's professionalism and dedication!
Our furry friends are in very good hands, without a doubt!

I've had my dog ​​since she was a puppy. She's always been very well treated and loves going to daycare and being with her friends.
Carolina is very helpful and always attentive to Tequila's behavior, so that we, the owners, can improve and adjust it.
We really appreciate the care and concern they always have for all the pets.
We are very satisfied and would recommend this daycare to other pet owners 🐶

Excellent dog daycare for leaving your furry friends.
Total dedication from the staff. Clean, safe, and well-decorated place. Themed parties. Mental stimulation activities. Happy dogs.
The best care for your fur babies!!! The space is so unique and very functional for them to socialize at their own pace and have fun at any time! They take excellent care of Penelope!

They are very careful with all the dogs, conscientious and attentive to their needs.
For me, it's touching to see the happiness with which Nicolau enters the daycare, as well as the satisfaction at the end of the day. I couldn't have chosen better!!

As a customer since the space opened, I couldn't be more satisfied with the professionalism, care, dedication, and responsibility that Carolina and her team have for my Camila and the other dogs! Always transparent, careful, so transparent that they are always sending photos and videos of how our furry friends are feeling, if they ate well, etc.
I couldn't be more satisfied, my Camila is so happy that when it's time to leave, she doesn't want to come back 😅 I am very grateful to Carolina and the rest of the team for being "home," for eating, and for giving them so much love! Thank you Carolina and team for everything, oh, and for the best birthday party 🩷 Camila is much happier since she met you 🩷🩷🩷

I have my dog ​​at C’s PET CARE and I couldn’t recommend the place more! Carolina and the whole team are an example of dedication and affection for all the dogs they care for daily as if they were their own! I wouldn’t trust my dog ​​to anyone else. The best ❤️
Daycare and dedication of excellence.

The best place in the world to take care of my dog. There's nothing bad to say. I recommend it to everyone. Carolina is spectacular. My Bali's happiness is visible in this photo! Thank you for all the love and care.

Bart is a very sociable but hyperactive dog. When we decided that it would be important for him to go to daycare, we didn't expect it to become so essential to his well-being.
Carolina is a dedicated, caring, and very hardworking person; Bart couldn't be in better hands. I doubt anyone has as much patience for little Bart's antics, and he's always so affectionate.
It's worth highlighting the daycare's evolution; it's a project full of love that has grown sustainably in a short time. It has more services, more students, the staff has increased, and we couldn't be more satisfied and even proud of this project.

100% trustworthy!
Beyond the immense affection that is evident for the animals, you can feel that there is a vocation for the work in question. Unfortunately, this doesn't always happen with other professionals, and that's why I think she deserves this feedback because she truly does an exemplary job. 👏🏼🥹
Kisses from Nicolau and Júlinha 🥰

Spectacular service! When your dog runs to enter the daycare door, we know we're in the right place. They are super careful with the dogs, and have immense love and dedication for what they do. I highly recommend them to anyone who wants happier and more sociable dogs.
The only place I trust to take my dog. Much more than just a "doggy daycare." The best place with the best professionals ❤️

It's impossible not to give it 5 stars!!

Carolina has spectacular creativity for this project. …
Congratulations on your success! I love it!

I frequently see and like your posts and I notice the affection and care you give to the animals. I want to meet you in person! I follow paçoca and pudim do Brasil in Olinda, Pernambuco. Thank you for all the posts and videos, they help ease my homesickness!

For my dog ​​to attend daycare for just one day, I have to pay for a behavior assessment simply because he is allergic to pollen, fleas, and other bugs.
They won't accept him attending daycare for just one day without a behavior …

We've been leaving Paçoca and Pudim at daycare weekly, and our experience has been truly excellent. From the start, we were very well received, and the care and attention they give to the dogs is evident in every detail. …
One of the best investments. Carolina is excellent and my Cookie is very happy there. Improvements at all levels regarding Cookie's behavior. Thank you.
Happy animals and people!
Best daycare for dogs! Fiapo has been going since he was 4 months old and simply LOVES it! He learned to socialize with other dogs and plays all day. Thank you Carolina for the wonderful work!!
Simply incredible! I'm 100% confident that Micas is happy in this space and is receiving so much love! I think she'll be sad to go back home :)
The affection and patience I showed Boris were essential in building a relationship of trust, and gave me peace of mind to leave him in Carolina's care.

We absolutely love C's Pet Care and the owner, Carolina.  She is experienced, very competent and so caring.  Our little furbaby, who suffers from severe separation anxiety, loves going to visit and actually pulls us toward the door! …

We are extremely satisfied with the services offered by Carolina and her team. From the first contact, we felt very reassured by the professionalism and care shown by the entire team. Viena was a little shy and fearful, but Carolina managed …
